description: This file contains utility functions and hooks for integrating ZeroRedundancyOptimizer (ZeRO) with DistributedDataParallel (DDP) in PyTorch. It facilitates overlapping optimizer steps with backward passes by providing various hooking mechanisms, including setup, local step execution, broadcasting, and interleaving strategies for optimized distributed training.

methods.name: _perform_local_step( bucket: dist.GradBucket, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, rank: int, )
methods.description: Performs a local optimizer step using gradients from a gradient bucket, updating the zero redundant optimizer accordingly.

methods.name: _broadcast_bucket( bucket_index: int, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, )
methods.description: Broadcasts a specific parameter bucket's tensor to synchronize parameters across ranks.

methods.name: _save_ddp_bucket_info( bucket: dist.GradBucket, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, )
methods.description: Saves information about a gradient bucket for overlap purposes, including parameters and size.

methods.name: _hook_with_zero_step_setup( ddp_ref: weakref.ReferenceType, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, bucket: dist.GradBucket, )
methods.description: Sets up the necessary state for overlapping ZeRO optimizer steps with DDP backward. It initializes overlap info, saves bucket info, and manages synchronization status.

methods.name: Callable[[Any,dist.GradBucket],torch.futures.Future[torch.Tensor]] hook_with_zero_step( hook: Callable[[Any, dist.GradBucket], torch.futures.Future], ddp: DistributedDataParallel, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, shard_buckets: bool = False, )
methods.description: Creates a hook that overlaps ZeRO optimizer steps with DDP backward pass, performing local steps after gradient buckets are computed and broadcasting parameters efficiently.

methods.name: Callable[[Any,dist.GradBucket],torch.futures.Future[torch.Tensor]] hook_with_zero_step_interleaved( hook: Callable[[Any, dist.GradBucket], torch.futures.Future], ddp: DistributedDataParallel, zero: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer, shard_buckets: bool = False, )
methods.description: Creates a hook that interleaves gradient reduction and optimizer updates, overlapping communication and computation in a fine-grained manner for improved efficiency.

methods.name: torch.futures.Future[torch.Tensor] hook_with_zero_fn( state: Any, bucket: dist.GradBucket, )
